about: Questions about the shop-docs fixture, with the lines that answer each and how brain_score.py recognises a right answer. Evidence names a file and the text of its first line (`match`), optionally of its last line (`through`); a citation that overlaps those lines cites the evidence. `allOf` lists groups of accepted values: the answer must contain one value of every group (case-insensitive). `kind` says what the question exercises: `descend` (two or more levels down by the summaries), `card` (an answer in a card with a reference id), `lookup` (the question names the id), `table` (a row of a table), `link` (a common component or decision), `grep` (a term that no title or summary shows), `disambiguate` (a near twin elsewhere gives another answer), `superseded` (a later decision replaced an earlier one), `long` (a document longer than one read), `multi-hop` (two documents together), `synonym` (the question uses other words than the document), `scale` (one of many look-alike units with cryptic names, written by `make_scale.py`), `refuse` (the documents do not hold the answer; `accept` adds phrasings of its own).
